scheme_name: Kisan Rail for Agri Produce Transport
overview: Kisan Rail for Agri Produce Transport is a scheme introduced by Indian Railways to facilitate the transportation of agricultural produce via dedicated freight trains, aiming to reduce post-harvest losses and improve farmers' income by ensuring timely and efficient movement of perishable goods across the country. The scheme leverages the existing rail network to connect farms with markets, supporting the agricultural supply chain.
objectives: To provide a seamless and cost-effective logistics solution for agricultural produce
To reduce wastage and spoilage of perishable goods during transit
To connect farmers directly with national and regional markets
To promote the use of rail transport for agri-logistics over road transport
To support the doubling of farmers' income by improving market access
To enhance the efficiency of the agricultural supply chain through dedicated freight services
eligibility: Farmers, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), cooperatives, agri-businesses, and other entities involved in the production and transportation of agricultural produce are eligible to utilize Kisan Rail services for transporting their goods.
benefits: Kisan Rail offers subsidized freight rates for agricultural commodities, ensures faster and safer transport of perishable goods, provides end-to-end logistics support including loading/unloading assistance, reduces dependency on road transport, minimizes post-harvest losses, and enables farmers to realize better prices by accessing distant markets in a timely manner.
financial_support: The scheme provides a subsidy of up to 50% on the freight charges for transporting fruits and vegetables via Kisan Rail, making it economically viable for small and marginal farmers to use rail logistics for their produce.
application_process: 1. Identify the agricultural produce to be transported and ensure it meets the eligibility criteria for Kisan Rail. 2. Contact the nearest railway freight office or authorized logistics partner. 3. Submit details of the consignment including origin, destination, quantity, and type of produce. 4. Complete the booking process through the Indian Railways freight portal or authorized agent. 5. Prepare the goods for loading as per railway guidelines. 6. Track the shipment using the railway consignment note. 7. Collect the delivered goods at the destination station upon arrival.
required_documents: Proof of ownership or authorization for the agricultural produce
Details of the consignment (type, quantity, origin, destination)
Farmer ID or FPO registration document (if applicable)
Vehicle or loading details for first/last mile connectivity
Government-issued ID proof of the consignor
deadlines: Rolling basis — services are available throughout the year based on demand and operational feasibility.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Railways, Government of India
contact_details: Email: cpio@rb.railnet.gov.in | Helpline: 139 (for public grievances) | Phone: (011) 23303849
caveats: Subsidy is applicable only for notified routes and specific agricultural commodities
Prior booking is required; services are subject to wagon and route availability
The consignor is responsible for first-mile and last-mile connectivity
Perishable goods must be properly packed to meet railway safety standards
The scheme does not cover non-agricultural freight
